examples.text: To our surprise, Jack scored 400 against an average of 250 in a recent English competition.
examples.translation: 令我们惊讶的是，Jack在最近的一次英语竞赛中得了400分，而平均分只有250分。
examples.speechText: To our surprise, Jack scored 400 against an average of 250 in a recent English competition.

examples.text: A child who downloads bad information or pictures can only be corrected（correct的过去分词形式） by positive family influence.
examples.translation: 孩子下载不良信息或图片的行为，只有依靠家庭的积极影响才能得到纠正。
examples.speechText: A child who downloads bad information or pictures can only be corrected by positive family influence.

examples.text: It can also prevent dry and heated（heat的过去分词形式） indoor air from leading to dry skin and brain fog.
examples.translation: 它还可以防止干燥、开着暖气的室内空气引起皮肤干燥和头脑昏沉。
examples.speechText: It can also prevent dry and heated indoor air from leading to dry skin and brain fog.

examples.text: For every writer kissed by fortune there are thousands more whose longing is never rewarded.
examples.translation: 每有一位受幸运眷顾的作家，就有成千上万位其他作家的梦想始终得不到回报。
examples.speechText: For every writer kissed by fortune there are thousands more whose longing is never rewarded.

examples.text: Although the poem contains such pessimistic overtones and pathetic acceptance of fate, there is hope to be found in the last two lines which seem to be set apart from the rest.
examples.translation: 虽然这首诗带有如此悲观的意味，以及令人伤感的认命态度，但看似与其余部分分开的最后两行中，仍能找到希望。
examples.speechText: Although the poem contains such pessimistic overtones and pathetic acceptance of fate, there is hope to be found in the last two lines which seem to be set apart from the rest.

examples.text: It is precisely this kind of conversation that is of importance when we are seeking to develop our reading to meet the new demands being placed upon us by studying at a higher level.
examples.translation: 当我们努力提高阅读能力，以满足更高层次学习对我们提出的新要求时，恰恰是这种对话十分重要。
examples.speechText: It is precisely this kind of conversation that is of importance when we are seeking to develop our reading to meet the new demands being placed upon us by studying at a higher level.

examples.text: The Romans counted it as from midnight, and most modern nations use this method.
examples.translation: 罗马人从午夜开始计算一天，如今大多数国家都采用这种方法。
examples.speechText: The Romans counted it as from midnight, and most modern nations use this method.

examples.text: Two thirds of adults globally are financially illiterate, according to Standard & Poor’s Global Financial Literacy Survey, and one in four teenagers are unable to make even simple decisions on everyday spending.
examples.translation: 根据标准普尔全球金融素养调查，全球三分之二的成年人缺乏基本金融知识，四分之一的青少年甚至无法就日常开支作出简单决定。
examples.speechText: Two thirds of adults globally are financially illiterate, according to Standard & Poor’s Global Financial Literacy Survey, and one in four teenagers are unable to make even simple decisions on everyday spending.

examples.text: By leaving room between their car and the one ahead of them, drivers can absorb a wave of braking in dense traffic conditions that would otherwise develop into a serious traffic jam with no obvious cause.
examples.translation: 在交通密集时，司机如果与前车留出距离，就能缓冲一波刹车带来的影响，否则这波刹车原本可能演变成一场没有明显原因的严重堵车。
examples.speechText: By leaving room between their car and the one ahead of them, drivers can absorb a wave of braking in dense traffic conditions that would otherwise develop into a serious traffic jam with no obvious cause.

examples.text: The elderly should change mindsets and imagine a brighter（bright的比较级） future.
examples.translation: 老年人应该转变思维方式，设想一个更光明的未来。
examples.speechText: The elderly should change mindsets and imagine a brighter future.

examples.text: Ballet training in Russia begins when a child is in the primary grades.
examples.translation: 在俄罗斯，芭蕾舞训练从孩子读小学时就开始了。
examples.speechText: Ballet training in Russia begins when a child is in the primary grades.

examples.text: Instead, you should think about things such as what your children want to get out of their media use and social situation.
examples.translation: 相反，你应该考虑孩子希望通过媒体使用和社交活动获得什么。
examples.speechText: Instead, you should think about things such as what your children want to get out of their media use and social situation.

examples.text: You and an opponent each throw one of three hand symbols.
examples.translation: 你和对手各自出示三种手势中的一种。
examples.speechText: You and an opponent each throw one of three hand symbols.

examples.text: Temperatures are warming and daylight lasts longer（long的比较级）.
examples.translation: 气温正在回升，白昼也越来越长。
examples.speechText: Temperatures are warming and daylight lasts longer.

examples.text: On his way home, he was killed in a car crash.
examples.translation: 在回家的路上，他因车祸身亡。
examples.speechText: On his way home, he was killed in a car crash.
